text: Good time management helps you get more done every day. First, make a plan for your day or week. You can write your tasks on a calendar or use an app to organize your schedule. It is helpful to choose your priority, which means the most important task first. If something is urgent, do it quickly. A deadline is the time when a task must be finished, so try not to delay your work. Some people are always punctual, which means they arrive on time or a little early, but other people are often late. Setting a reminder can help you remember an important appointment or task. It is good to have a daily routine, like waking up, eating, and working at the same time every day. A routine helps you focus and manage your time better. When you plan well, you can achieve your goals faster. However, it is also important to find a balance between work and rest. If you work all the time without resting, you will become tired. Good time management is not about doing everything, but about doing the right things at the right time.
